name: College of Dance

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A bard whose magic flows through movement: unarmored grace, inspired Unarmed Strikes and an ensemble that moves as one.

feature.name: Dazzling Footwork
feature.summary: Without armor or a Shield: AC 10 + Dex + Cha, Advantage on dancing Performance, and Bardic Inspiration fuels Unarmed Strikes that use your Bardic die.
feature.text: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield you gain these benefits. Dance Virtuoso: Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks that involve dancing. Unarmored Defense: your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers. Agile Strikes: when you expend a use of Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, Bonus Action or Reaction, you can also make one Unarmed Strike. Bardic Damage: your Unarmed Strikes can use Dexterity for the attack roll, and their damage equals your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Dexterity modifier (Bludgeoning) in place of the usual amount.

feature.name: Inspiring Movement
feature.summary: Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet: spend Bardic Inspiration to move half your Speed, and an ally can move too.
feature.text: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction and expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed. One ally within 30 feet of you can then use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed. None of this movement provokes Opportunity Attacks.

feature.name: Tandem Footwork
feature.summary: When you roll Initiative, spend Bardic Inspiration to add the die to your roll and to nearby allies' rolls.
feature.text: When you roll Initiative and aren't Incapacitated, you can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration, roll the die, and add the number to your Initiative and to the Initiative of each ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you.

feature.name: Leading Evasion
feature.summary: You gain Evasion, and creatures within 5 feet caught in the same effect share it.
